name: 帮图CAD建筑图纸解析
description: 上传 DWG 图纸，自动识别图框与图签，并提取建筑专业 23 类构件（轴号、房间、门、窗、楼梯、立面、剖面、门窗表等）的结构化结果。适合图纸识别与 BIM 数据化。
description_zh: 上传 DWG 图纸，自动识别图框与图签，并提取建筑专业 23 类构件（轴号、房间、门、窗、楼梯、立面、剖面、门窗表等）的结构化结果。适合图纸识别与 BIM 数据化。
description_en: Upload DWG drawings, auto-detect frames and title blocks, and extract structured results for 23 building categories (axis numbers, rooms, doors, windows, stairs, facades, sections, door/window schedules, etc.). Ideal for drawing recognition and BIM data digitization.
examples_zh: 上传一张 DWG 图纸，识别其中的图框和图签。
根据图框 frameId，识别建筑专业的房间、门和窗。
查询一个 DWG 识别任务是否已完成。
获取建筑专业楼梯详图的结构化结果。
examples_en: Upload a DWG drawing and extract its frame and title block info.
Identify building rooms, doors and windows from a frameId.
Check whether a DWG recognition task has finished.
Get structured stair detail results for a building task.
